db_alignment.note: Fields map to core_engine/database/schema.sql tables where indicated. New mass-valuation tables are defined in data_models.schema.json and deferred to P1 migration.

property_id.missing_policy: reject — property_id is the anchor key; no record without it
property_id.db_column: comparables.id (UUID) or external source ID before reconciliation
property_id.notes: Source system IDs must be deduplicated before ingestion.

property_type.missing_policy: reject — property_type determines applicable valuation method and IAAO COD threshold; cannot be imputed

city.missing_policy: reject — city is part of location identity; no statistical imputation permitted
city.notes: Saudi canonical cities list defined separately. No imputation for location fields.

district.missing_policy: flag_for_review — district enriches spatial analysis but its absence does not block ingestion; must not be imputed statistically
district.notes: Geocoding to district from coordinates is permitted only if coordinates are verified (see coordinates field).

address.missing_policy: allow_null — address is descriptive; absence documented in record
address.notes: Free-text field. Sanitised by input_validator before storage.

coordinates.missing_policy: allow_null — if missing: documented_absence; if incorrect: flag_for_review. Geocoding from address is permitted only if address is verified and geocoding source is logged (see source_log.py pattern).
coordinates.notes: Bounds set for Saudi Arabia. Coordinates outside bounds rejected — not imputed.

land_area_m2.missing_policy: exclude_or_manual_review — land area is a primary valuation input; zero or negative values rejected; missing value triggers manual_review_required status

built_up_area_m2.missing_policy: allow_null_for_land_use — for built assets: flag_for_review if missing; not imputed
built_up_area_m2.notes: Required for income and cost approaches in P1.

rentable_area_m2.missing_policy: allow_null — if income approach used and rentable_area missing: insufficient_evidence status for that method
rentable_area_m2.notes: Not in existing schema — new field for mass valuation. Added to MassValuationRun in P1.

age.missing_policy: optional_sector_imputation — age may be imputed as sector median with explicit quality_flag='age_imputed_sector_median'; imputation logged in provenance. Price/location fields NEVER imputed.
age.notes: year_built accepted as alternative; age = current_year − year_built.

condition.missing_policy: default_to_unknown — condition defaults to 'unknown' if missing; flagged in quality layer; no value imputation

use.missing_policy: default_to_unknown — use type defaults to 'unknown' if missing; documented in record
use.notes: Relevant for income approach — unknown use → insufficient_evidence for rental methods.

transaction_date.missing_policy: reject — transaction_date is required for temporal validation and ratio study; missing date = excluded from time-series analysis
transaction_date.notes: Lookback window defined per run in standard_version config (default 36 months for SA residential).

transaction_price.missing_policy: exclude_from_ratio_study — transaction_price missing: record excluded from COD/PRD/PRB analysis; NOT imputed statistically. Record retained for spatial context only.
transaction_price.db_column: comparables.price_egp (field name legacy — SA platform uses SAR)
transaction_price.notes: CRITICAL: Price is never statistically imputed. Zero price → rejected. Isolation Forest flags for human review only.

evidence_type.missing_policy: default_to_unknown — evidence type defaults to 'unknown' but is documented; affects confidence score in provenance
evidence_type.notes: Registered sales receive highest confidence weight in IAAO ratio studies.

occupancy.missing_policy: allow_null — if income approach used and occupancy missing: insufficient_evidence for rental methods; not imputed
occupancy.notes: New field for mass valuation income analysis.

quality_finish.missing_policy: default_to_unknown — quality/finish defaults to 'unknown'; documented in quality layer
quality_finish.notes: Maps to both finishing_level and quality_tier in the existing comparables table.

notes: advisory_only=True — no automated certification or approval.
Location fields (city, coordinates) are NEVER statistically imputed.
Isolation Forest and Z-score anomaly detection = flag_for_review only, not auto-delete.
All missing values produce documented absence states, not zeros or averages.
